freeze_timing: frozen after the one authorized execution completed but before loading either runtime JSON array or any split-timing values
reason_for_amendment: the pre-execution protocol froze the moving-block lengths and decision thresholds but omitted the bootstrap repetition count, seed and exact resampling implementation

point_statistics.stage_fraction: sample median of the stage divided by the sample median of split total
point_statistics.dominant_stage: the stage with the largest point-estimate stage_fraction
point_statistics.absolute_residual: absolute value of residual_us before summarization
point_statistics.split_total_ratio: sample median of split total divided by the frozen Phase3C10 total median

bootstrap.sample_construction: draw ceil(n/block_length) circular block starts uniformly with replacement, concatenate each forward block modulo n, then truncate to n rows
bootstrap.interval: percentile interval using numpy.quantile method=linear at 0.025 and 0.975
bootstrap.interpretation: single-traversal conditional only; not between-run uncertainty

claim_limits: one execution cannot establish between-run stability
the identity-L8 control is not a measured or standardized fading trace
timing attribution does not validate absolute RSRP equivalence or authorize calibration
no threshold may be changed after the values are loaded
